title: A formally smooth model of the closed fibre before lifting its map
statement: Let $\alpha:A_0\to A$ and $\varphi:A\to B$ be local homomorphisms of complete Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], with the specified algebra structures induced by these maps. Suppose $\alpha$ induces an isomorphism of residue fields and $E=B/\mathfrak m_A B$ is formally smooth over $A/\mathfrak m_A$ for the image of $\mathfrak m_B$ [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Then there are a complete Noetherian local $A_0$-algebra $C$, a local structure map $\gamma:A_0\to C$ formally smooth for the maximal-ideal topology, and a surjection $\theta:C\to E$ with $\ker\theta=\mathfrak m_0C$ and $\theta\gamma=\pi\varphi\alpha$, where $\pi:B\to E$ is the quotient map. No finiteness of $\alpha$ or flatness of $\varphi$ is assumed. The carrier $C$ is placed in the maximum universe of the input rings.

source.place: Remark 07NS first paragraph, Lemma 07NR; steps 1–2 of lem-weil-pbc-fs-adic-lift-over-finite-coefficient-map.

proof.text: *The closed fibre.* As $\varphi$ is local, $\mathfrak m_AB\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$ is a proper ideal, so by [lem-weil-pbc-complete-local-quotient] $\overline B=B/\mathfrak m_AB$ is a Noetherian local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_{\overline B}=\mathfrak m_B/\mathfrak m_AB$ and is $\mathfrak m_{\overline B}$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $\pi:B\to\overline B$ be the quotient map. Since $\pi\varphi$ kills $\mathfrak m_A$, $\overline B$ is a $k$-algebra, and through the residue isomorphism $\bar\alpha:k_0=A_0/\mathfrak m_0\xrightarrow{\sim}k$ a $k_0$-algebra; the composite $A_0\to k_0\to k\to\overline B$ is $\pi\varphi\alpha$. A homomorphism of $k$-algebras is the same as a homomorphism of $k_0$-algebras for the structure through the isomorphism $\bar\alpha$, so the lifting condition of [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic] for $k\to\overline B$ (hypothesis) is the one for $k_0\to\overline B$: $\overline B$ is formally smooth over $k_0$ for the $\mathfrak m_{\overline B}$-adic topology.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-fs-adic-lift-from-residue-field] to the complete local closed fibre over k₀. Compose its A₀-algebra isomorphism C/m₀C ≅ E with the quotient map to obtain θ. The quotient map is onto and its kernel is m₀C; the isomorphism is injective, hence composing preserves this kernel. Algebra compatibility gives θγ=πφα. If necessary transport to ULift C in the maximum input universe; ring, maximal ideal, completion and lifting properties transport along the canonical ring equivalence. Formal smoothness under universe enlargement is checked by restricting a lifting problem to the small subalgebra generated by the image and square-zero lift representatives before applying the original lifting condition. This supplies only C and θ, not a map into B or a tensor isomorphism.
